# Generated by harpia Stage 13 (DDS transport). Do not edit.
#
# Build scaffolding for the DDS transport headers in this directory. A
# consuming project does:
#
#     add_subdirectory(generated/cpp/dds)
#     target_link_libraries(<your_target> PRIVATE harpia_dds_transport)
#
# and then `#include "dds/<name>_<hash>_dds.h"` (via -I generated/cpp).
#
# Turns harpia_dds_frame.idl (the one opaque topic type every generated DDS
# transport publishes on) into C++ with Cyclone's idlc + the idlcxx plugin,
# compiles it *here* (so the generated .hpp does not leak into consumers as
# an unresolved INTERFACE source -- idlcxx_generate's INTERFACE lib carries
# the raw generated files, which only resolve in the directory that ran it),
# and rolls it up with ddscxx into one target consumers link.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

if(NOT TARGET CycloneDDS-CXX::ddscxx)
  find_package(CycloneDDS-CXX REQUIRED)
endif()

idlcxx_generate(
  TARGET harpia_dds_frame_idl
  FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/harpia_dds_frame.idl")

set(_frame_cpp "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/harpia_dds_frame.cpp")
set_source_files_properties("${_frame_cpp}" PROPERTIES GENERATED TRUE)

add_library(harpia_dds_transport STATIC "${_frame_cpp}")
add_dependencies(harpia_dds_transport harpia_dds_frame_idl_generate)
target_include_directories(harpia_dds_transport PUBLIC
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(harpia_dds_transport PUBLIC CycloneDDS-CXX::ddscxx)
